pages.text: The Oil Pumpjack alpha is a single-block version of Arcforge’s Pumpjack. Place it in the Overworld on a chunk covered by a deposit reported by the Seismic Survey Tool. It needs 60 FE/t, accepts up to 1,000 FE/t, and stores 100,000 FE.

It pumps Crude Oil or Sour Crude Oil into its 16,000 mB output tank. A full deposit yields 30 mB/t and slows toward 25% of that rate as it empties; after depletion it continues at 40 mB/s. Deposit depletion is shared and saved in the world’s data folder. Connect a Fluid Conduit to the Pumpjack to transfer oil. Use the Wrench to check its field, tank, rate, and energy.

This alpha uses the same seed-based regional deposit model as the survey tool. It does not yet form Arcforge’s 3×5 pumpjack structure or connect to derrick-built wellheads, and it does not generate oil caverns or gas.
